definitions.explanation: Indicates that a state continues or persists.
Used to add supplementary information, often in formal contexts.
Indicates an intensification of a state or quality.

examples.japanese: ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧なお⟦{解決|かいけつ}していない→解決：00136_kaiketsu⟧。
examples.english: The problem still hasn't been resolved.

examples.japanese: なお、⟦{詳|くわ}しく→詳しい：02483_kuwashii⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ホームページ→ホームページ：05869_hoomupeeji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ご{覧|らん}ください→ご覧：01408_goran⟧。
examples.english: Furthermore, please see our website for details.

examples.japanese: ⟦{練習|れんしゅう}すれば→練習：05323_renshuu⟧、なお⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: If you practice, you'll become even better.

notes:
なお has multiple uses depending on context.

STILL/YET (continuation):
- なお〜ている (is still ~ing)
- なお{続|つづ}く (still continues)
- Often indicates something persists longer than expected

FURTHERMORE (formal addition):
- Very common in business writing, announcements
- なお、〜 (Furthermore, ~; Note: ~; Also, ~)
- Adds supplementary or clarifying information

EVEN MORE (intensification):
- なお + comparative/intensifying expression
- なお{良|よ}い (even better)
- なおさら (all the more; even more so)

KANJI:
- Can be written as {尚|なお} or {猶|なお} in formal writing
- Usually written in hiragana in modern usage
